title: Tell the Coming Generation

questions.question: Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:1 (ESV): "Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my mouth!"

questions.question: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings from of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:2 (ESV): "I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings from of old,"

questions.question: We will not hide them from their children, but tell to the coming generation the glorious deeds of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:4 (ESV): "...but tell to the coming generation the glorious deeds of the Lord,"

questions.question: He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:5 (ESV): "He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel,"

questions.question: They should set their hope in God and not forget the works of God, but keep his what?
The Ephraimites, armed with the bow, turned back on the day of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:9 (ESV): "The Ephraimites, armed with the bow, turned back on the day of battle."

questions.question: They did not keep God's covenant, but refused to walk according to his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:10 (ESV): "They did not keep God's covenant, but refused to walk according to his law."

questions.question: He divided the sea and let them pass through it, and made the waters stand like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:13 (ESV): "...and made the waters stand like a heap."

questions.question: In the daytime he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a fiery what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:14 (ESV): "...and all the night with a fiery light."

questions.question: He split rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink abundantly as from the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:15 (ESV): "...and gave them drink abundantly as from the deep."

questions.question: They tested God in their heart by demanding the food they what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:18 (ESV): "They tested God in their heart by demanding the food they craved."

questions.question: Man ate of the bread of the angels; he sent them food in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:25 (ESV): "Man ate of the bread of the angels; he sent them food in abundance."

questions.question: He rejected the tent of Joseph; he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim; but he chose the tribe of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:67-68 (ESV): "...but he chose the tribe of Judah,"

questions.question: He chose David his servant and took him from the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:70 (ESV): "He chose David his servant and took him from the sheepfolds;"

questions.question: With upright heart he shepherded them and guided them with his skillful what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 78:72 (ESV): "...and guided them with his skillful hand."

key_verse_text: We will not hide them from their children, but tell to the coming generation the glorious deeds of the Lord, and his might, and the wonders that he has done.
